title: Psalm 91 Prayer For Protection | Under His Wings (KJV) | Cover Your Home And Family
description:
Psalm 91 prayer for protection, read from the King James Bible and prayed over your home and family.

Walk through Psalm 91 verse by verse: the secret place, under his wings, the terror by night, his angels, and the line people miss, I will be with him in trouble. Ends with a prayer of covering.

"He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty. I will say of the LORD, He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust." Psalm 91:1-2 (KJV)

Scriptures in this video (KJV): Psalm 91:1-2, Psalm 91:3-4, Psalm 91:5-6, John 16:33, Psalm 91:9-10, Proverbs 18:10, Psalm 91:11-12, Psalm 91:14-16, 2 Timothy 1:7, Isaiah 41:10.

Type amen in the comments, and send this to a friend who needs it. Subscribe to Blessed Prayers for more.
